simple.meaning: סִינִי (Çîynîy) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a Sinite , or descendant of one of the sons of Canaan.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Genesis, 1 Chronicles, beginning at Genesis 10:17. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סִינִי (H5513).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
